title: 第267章 甲子寿数第266章 机缘
slug: 西游刚准备尸解成仙猴子来找
content_zh:
杨明提了笤帚，又快步顺着山道回到山门前来。那何章三人正立在门外等候，王飞性子急，已来回踱了好几圈，见杨明下来，忙道：“如何？”
杨明将笤帚往肩上一搭，道：“我师父请三位上山一叙。”
何章微微一怔，倒不曾想这山中主人竟肯亲自会见，当下拱手道：“多谢道友引路。”
三人随着杨明，沿着那条青石山道拾级而上。一路松柏苍翠，鸟雀不惊，山中灵气沛然，越往上走越是浓厚。何章暗中留意，面上不动声色，心中却已有了计较，这等灵山福地，绝非寻常隐士能占得住的。
行了约莫半盏茶工夫，便到了那石台之前。
陶潜坐在旧木椅上，膝前搁着那根木拐棍，一身白袍，头上随意挽了个髻，拿根木簪别着，瞧去不过是个干瘦老头。
可何章三人方走到近前，便不约而同脚下一滞，面色齐变了。
只因他三人虽本事平，到底修了两百余年，这双眼还是有几分道行的。此刻定睛一看，那老者周身隐隐有青白二气环绕，如烟如雾，聚散无定。这等气象，分明是个地仙！
三人心头皆是一凛。地仙者，已超脱凡人寿数之限，与天地同参造化，岂是他们这等连人仙门槛都未摸着的散修可比？
何章当先反应过来，连忙撩起衣袍，纳头便拜：“晚辈何章，拜见前辈！不知前辈在此，多有冒犯！”
王飞与陆长留也不敢怠慢，齐跪了下去，行了大礼。
陶潜抬了抬手中拐棍，往虚处一点：“起来罢，不须多礼。”
三人站起身来，垂手侍立，再不敢有半分先前的轻慢。
陶潜将三人打量了一回，也不兜圈子，开口便道：“你们追那人参精入山，要拿它炼丹，好修成人仙，这事我已知道了。”
何章低头道：“那精怪乃晚辈三人先寻着的根脚，追了七八日方至此处。若有冒犯前辈道场之处，还望前辈恕罪。”
陶潜摆了摆手：“说不上冒犯。你们追拿妖精炼丹以求长生，本也是修行中人的寻常路数，没甚么错处。只是……”
他顿了一顿，把拐棍在膝上敲了两下。
“只是那精怪跑到了贫道这山中来，便算求到了我门上。既然求到了门上，贫道便不好坐视不理。这个缘分既落在我这头，这精怪贫道便收下了，你三人不可再打它的主意。”
王飞心中一急，嘴唇动了动，到底不敢在地仙跟前放肆，只把拳头攥紧了，脸憋得通红。
何章心中也是不甘，可人在屋檐下，不得不低头。他斟酌了一回，硬着头皮道：“前辈所言，晚辈不敢不从。只是……晚辈三人修行两百余年，至今不得寸进，眼看寿数将尽，再吃丹药也延不得几年了。此番追拿那精怪，实是指望它作那入道的引子。如今这条路断了，晚辈三人恐怕……”

说到此处，何章也不再说下去，只低着头，面上尽是颓丧之色。
陶潜也不接何章的话茬，只拿那双浑浊老眼将三人从头到脚看了一遍，开口问道：“你三人还有几年寿数？”
何章三人对视一眼，皆是苦笑。何章低声道：“回前辈的话，晚辈三人先前服食延寿丹药，勉强续了百余年光阴。只是如今丹力已尽，再吃也不顶用了。照眼下这副身子骨来算，至多……五年。”
王飞在旁攥着拳头，咬牙道：“五年都是往宽里说的。陆兄弟这两年已时常气血不继，恐怕三四年便要不济。”
陆长留拄着铁杖，默默点头，并不争辩。
陶潜听罢，也不动容，又问：“若贫道再给你三人一甲子寿数，你等可修成人仙否？”
此言一出，何章三人浑身一震，齐齐抬起头来，眼中皆露出不敢置信之色。
何章嘴唇翕动了两下，声音都有些发颤：“前辈此言……当真？可莫要骗我们，如今延寿的丹药对我们起不起作用了，不是因为药力，而是因为丹药延寿延到了极限。”
陶潜把拐棍在地上点了一点：“贫道问你能不能，不曾问你信不信。”
何章定了定神，深吸一口气，正色道：“回前辈，若有六十年光阴，晚辈三人定能修成。”
他说这话倒非虚言。这三人在山中苦修两百余年，根基早已夯得扎实，丹田中后天之气凝聚，差的不过是临门一脚的火候。
人仙果位，说白了便是将周身气血精元练至圆满无缺，五脏六腑俱得真气浸润，能将自身寿数大大延长到达极限。
他三人如今好比那烧了七八成的瓷器，只差最后那把窑火。五年太短，火候不到便要出窑，自然烧不成器。可若有六十年从容调息行功，以他们的底子，修成人仙不过是水到渠成之事。
陶潜点了点头，从那旧木椅上站起身来，拿拐棍往前一指：“既如此，贫道便送你们一场造化，给你们延六十年的寿命，六十年内你等若修不成人仙，那便是命数如此，怨不得旁人，毕竟就算那精怪不跑到贫道山中来，跑到别处去，你们能不能抓住它也是个未知数。”
何章三人闻言，如遭雷击，愣了半晌，随即齐齐跪倒在地，砰砰砰磕了三个响头。何章声音发颤道：“前辈大恩，晚辈三人粉身碎骨难报万一！”
陶潜拿拐棍点了点地，道：“起来罢。那人参精既入了我山中，便是我门下的人了，你三人日后莫再寻它的晦气。”
三人连声应诺，爬将起来，面上犹带喜色。王飞心中虽有几分不甘那精怪到嘴的肥肉飞了，可白得六十年寿数，且是地仙亲口许诺，哪里还敢多说半个不字。
陶潜转头朝杨明道：“去后山松林，将空山客唤来。”
杨明应了一声，提起笤帚便往后山去了。
何章三人立在石台前，大气也不敢多喘一口。过了约莫一盏茶光景，便听得松林中蹄声细碎，一道雪白身影从林间踱了出来。

content_en:
Yang Ming picked up the broom and quickly walked back to the mountain gate along the mountain path. He Zhang and the others were standing outside the door waiting. Wang Fei was impatient and had walked back and forth several times. When he saw Yang Ming coming down, he hurriedly asked: "How is it?"
Yang Ming put the broom on his shoulder and said, "My master invites the three of you to go up the mountain to talk."
He Zhang was slightly startled. He never thought that the master of the mountain would be willing to meet him in person. He immediately cupped his hands and said, "Thank you, fellow Taoist, for showing the way."
The three of them followed Yang Ming and climbed up the bluestone mountain road. The pines and cypresses are green all the way, the birds are not frightened, and the mountain is full of spiritual energy, which becomes stronger as you go up. He Zhang secretly paid attention, with a calm expression on his face, but he was already thinking about it in his heart. This kind of blessed land in Lingshan is definitely not something that ordinary hermits can occupy.
After walking for about half a cup of tea, we arrived in front of the stone platform.
Tao Qian was sitting on an old wooden chair, with the wooden walking stick in front of his knees. He was dressed in a white robe, with a bun on his head and a wooden hairpin pinned to it. He looked like a skinny old man.
But when He Zhang and the three of them came closer, they all stopped in unison and their expressions changed.
Just because although the three of them are average in ability, after all, they have practiced for more than two hundred years, and their eyes are still somewhat wise. Taking a closer look at this moment, the old man was faintly surrounded by two green and white auras, like smoke and mist, gathering and dispersing indefinitely. With this kind of weather, he is clearly an earthly immortal!
All three of them were stunned. Earthly immortals have transcended the life span of mortals and participated in creation with heaven and earth. How can they be compared to casual cultivators like them who have not even touched the threshold of human immortality?
He Zhang reacted first, quickly lifted up his robe, bowed his head and bowed: "Junior He Zhang, greetings to senior! I didn't know that senior is here, how offensive it is!"
Wang Fei and Lu Changliu did not dare to neglect, they both knelt down and saluted.
Tao Qian raised the crutch in his hand and pointed it towards the empty space: "Get up, there is no need to be polite."
The three of them stood up and stood with their hands down, not daring to show any slightest hint of their previous arrogance.
Tao Qian looked at the three of them for a while, and without going around in circles, he said: "You are chasing the ginseng essence into the mountains to use it to make elixirs so that you can become immortals. I already know this."
He Zhang lowered his head and said: "The spirit was the one the three juniors found first, and they chased it for seven or eight days before arriving here. If I have offended the senior dojo in any way, I hope you will forgive me."
Tao Qian waved his hand: "I can't say it's offensive. You are chasing goblins to refine elixirs in order to seek immortality. This is also a common way for practitioners. There is nothing wrong with it. It's just..."
He paused and tapped the cane twice on his knees.
"It's just that when the spirit came to Pindao's mountain, it was begged at my door. Now that it's begged at the door, Pindao can't sit back and ignore it. Now that this fate has fallen on my side, Pindao accepts this spirit. You and the three of you can't have any more ideas about it."
Wang Fei felt anxious and moved his lips. He didn't dare to act recklessly in front of the Earthly Immortal. He only clenched his fists tightly and his face turned red from holding back.
He Zhang was also unwilling to give in, but he had to bow his head under the eaves. He thought about it for a while, then said bravely: "Senior said, I dare not disobey. It's just that... the three of us have been practicing for more than two hundred years, but they can't make any progress so far. They are about to end their lifespan, and they can't take pills for a few more years. This time we are chasing the spirit, hoping that it will serve as an introduction to the Tao. Now that this road is blocked, the three of us are afraid..."
At this point, He Zhang stopped talking and just lowered his head, with a look of dejection on his face.
Tao Qian didn't answer He Zhang's words. He looked at the three of them from head to toe with his turbid old eyes and asked, "How many years do you three have left?"
He Zhang and the other three looked at each other and smiled bitterly. He Zhang whispered: "Returning to the seniors, the three juniors took the life-extending elixir before and managed to survive for more than a hundred years. But now the elixir's power has been exhausted, and it is no longer useful to take it anymore. Based on the current body and bones, at most... five years."
Wang Fei clenched his fists at the side and gritted his teeth and said: "I've been talking to Kuanli for five years. Brother Lu has often lost his energy and blood in the past two years. I'm afraidI'm afraid that I'll be in trouble in three or four years. "
Lu Changliu leaned on the iron staff and nodded silently without arguing.
After hearing this, Tao Qian was unmoved and asked again: "If I give you three more people a lifetime, will you be able to become an immortal?" "
As soon as these words came out, He Zhang and the other two people were shocked, and they all raised their heads with disbelief in their eyes.
He Zhang's lips moved twice, and his voice trembled: "Senior, do you really mean what you said...? But don’t lie to us. Today’s life-extending elixirs no longer work for us. It’s not because of the potency, but because the elixirs extend life to the limit. "
Tao Qian tapped his walking stick on the ground: "I asked you if you could do it, but I didn't ask you if you believe it. "
He Zhang composed himself, took a deep breath, and said seriously: "Senior, if we have sixty years, the three juniors will definitely be able to complete it. "
He was not lying when he said this. These three people have practiced hard in the mountains for more than two hundred years, and have already laid a solid foundation. The acquired energy in their Dantian has condensed, and the only difference is the heat at the last moment.
To put it bluntly, the human immortal state is to cultivate the Qi, blood and essence of the whole body to perfection, and all the internal organs can be infiltrated with the true Qi, which can greatly extend one's life span to the limit.
The three of them are now like the porcelain that is 70 to 80% fired, only the last kiln fire is missing. Five years is too short. It will be out of the kiln before the fire is ready, and naturally it will not be fired. However, if they have sixty years to calmly adjust their breath and practice Qigong, with their background, becoming an immortal is just a matter of course.
Tao Qian nodded, stood up from the old wooden chair, and pointed forward with his walking stick: "In that case, Pindao will give you a blessing and extend your lifespan by sixty years. If you can't become an immortal within sixty years, it will be your fate. You can't blame others. After all, even if the spirit doesn't come to Pindao Mountain and goes somewhere else, it's still unknown whether you can catch it. "
When He Zhang and the other three heard this, they felt as if they were struck by lightning. They were stunned for a long time, and then they all knelt down on the ground and kowtowed three times. He Zhang's voice trembled as he said: "Senior, I've been so kind to you. It's hard to repay the three juniors if they were shattered into pieces! "
Tao Qian tapped the ground with his walking stick and said, "Get up. Now that the ginseng essence has entered my mountain, it has become my disciple. The three of you should not seek its bad luck in the future. "
The three of them agreed and climbed up, their faces still full of joy. Although Wang Fei was a little unwilling to lose the weird fat in his mouth, his sixty years of life were in vain. Moreover, it was promised by the Earth Immortal himself, so he didn't dare to say no more.
Tao Qian turned to Yang Ming and said: "Go to the pine forest in the back mountain and call the empty mountain guest. "
Yang Ming responded, picked up the broom and headed towards the back mountain.
He Zhang and the others stood in front of the stone platform, not daring to take a breath. After about a cup of tea, I heard the sound of hoofbeats in the pine forest, and a snow-white figure walked out of the forest.
